Good. All TypeScript errors in deploy-cloudflare are resolved and the build is clean. Here's a summary of the full CF-native execution picture:

**Execution routing (in priority order):**

| Path | When used |
|---|---|
| `SIDECAR_SERVICE` (CF Container Fetcher) | CF deployment with container configured — preferred |
| `SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL` from KV | Fallback when container binding absent (external server) |

**What each container does:**
- `SIDECAR_SERVICE` → companion Node.js server; handles `/internal/heartbeat`, `/internal/plugin-jobs/:id/claim|execute|complete`
- `PLUGIN_CONTAINER` → isolated sandbox; handles `POST /execute` / `POST /cancel/:runId` for adapter command execution (used when `executorMode === "container"`)

**To activate in production:**
```
wrangler deploy  # picks up [[containers]] from wrangler.toml
```
No `SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL` KV entry needed once the containers are running — the Worker prefers the binding.
